items.title: 'It's a free-for-all': Fiji 'ground zero' for a transnational drug-smuggling trade
items.description: Two men have told Foreign Correspondent how they were unwittingly drawn into Fiji's largest-ever meth importation.

items.title: Live: Iran threatens to close Strait of Hormuz again if US naval blockade continues
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he intends to keep up his naval blockade of Iran until a peace agreement is signed; however, Iran's top negotiator says this is a breach of the current ceasefire deal. Follow live.

items.title: Indemnified soldiers give evidence in war veteran's case, documents show
items.description: Ben Roberts-Smith was on Friday granted bail in the NSW Local Court, with his case over war crimes charges expected to return to court in early June.

items.title: Why Australian tea tree oil could be banned in Europe
items.description: The EU is considering banning Australian tea tree oil after a study raised concerns about potential reproductive risks, a move industry leaders warn could devastate exports and trigger global impacts.

items.title: Triple murderer Erin Patterson's estranged husband writing his memoir
items.description: Simon Patterson, who claims his murderous ex-wife tried to poison him on several occasions, is pursuing a book deal, his media manager has announced.

items.title: World's largest democracy votes against increasing women
items.description: The largest democracy in the world has rejected a move to increase the number of women in parliament. What could have been a 'beacon' for global women's rights became marred by controversy.

items.title: Live: Suns hold off Bombers in thriller, Bulldogs star out for season
items.description: The Gold Coast Suns dig deep to hold off a confident Essendon side to win by nine points, while the Bulldogs' worst fears are realised. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Warriors finishing tries in style to take big lead over Titans
items.description: The New Zealand Warriors scored four tries in a dominant first half over the Gold Coast Titans in Auckland. Follow live.

items.title: Desperate for social media ban to work, but parents say it’s 'impossible'
items.description: Tech companies are coming under fire as Australian parents increasingly voice concerns that some online platforms are failing to keep kids under 16 off their platforms.

items.title: The world faces a grim reality, even if Trump exists in a different one
items.description: The world is stuck watching a performative series of announcements about meetings that could, may, will happen, involving a president not dealing with the reality that he is in a weak and confused bargaining position.

items.title: Australia enters drone warfare era with Ghost Bat and Ghost Shark
items.description: Australia is on a push to keep pace with the rapid evolution of drone warfare, with an emphasis on locally produced Ghost Bat and Ghost Shark systems.

items.title: Harry and Meghan seek duty and dollars on tour
items.description: Mixing philanthropy, influencing and brand building, Harry and Meghan’s Australian tour revives a question Queen Elizabeth once shut down: can the 'half in, half out' royal life work?

items.title: Not all city suburbs have NBN access and it isn't by accident. Here's why
items.description: Despite popular belief, not all Australians are guaranteed access to the NBN — and as many consumers have discovered, alternative networks do not always provide quality service.

items.title: Gout celebrates early to win another title, but wait continues for milestone mark
items.description: Gout Gout waves goodbye to his opponents en route to another national under-20 title in the 100m, as the wait goes on for him to dip below the 10-second barrier.

items.title: Skip the takeaway. This halloumi wrap is quicker and healthy too
items.description: The only cooking in this simple dinner is the halloumi. It has takeaway vibes and just the right balance of flavours to become a family favourite.

items.title: Old is new again: Gen alpha takes to old tech with fresh eyes
items.description: With the constant evolution of the digital world, community history is rapidly disappearing into memories and museums. But a historical society on WA's south coast is delighting today's kids by showing them the technology older Australians grew up with.

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of the Big Day Out, footy fairytales and the circles of hell
items.description: Every question has only two options: one is right, and the other is wrong. You have an even chance of guessing correctly each time.

items.title: National 'Walk for Truth' asks PM to deliver on long-awaited promise
items.description: Indigenous leader Travis Lovett sets off on a trek to Canberra, calling for action from the federal government to support a national truth-telling process for First Nations people.

items.title: Outcry over 'disturbing' video of off-duty police officer pinning 13yo girl on train
items.description: Video of an off-duty police officer restraining a 13yo girl on a Perth train has sparked accusations of excessive force.

items.title: NT councils could cut access to pools, street lights due to power price hike
items.description: Power price hikes are expected to be passed onto local councils by the Northern Territory government in the coming month, with Darwin's lord mayor warning some community services could be cut as a result.

items.title: Search underway for man missing from cruise ship off Brisbane
items.description: Carnival Cruise Line has confirmed it is assisting authorities in a search for a missing man.

items.title: Patients with little-known neurological condition wait years for diagnosis
items.description: People with functional neurological disorder say they experience misdiagnosis and struggles within the medical system.

items.title: Two words threaten to derail Minns's plan to ban controversial phrase
items.description: NSW Premier Chris Minns must now decide whether to proceed with the next restrictions he hoped to impose on protests after his latest court defeat.

items.title: Toddler's death at Perth hospital was 'probably preventable'
items.description: The death of a toddler at one of Perth's major hospitals was "probably preventable" and the failure to perform a blood test on him was "more than a missed opportunity", a coroner finds.

items.title: An executive at FIFA's new betting partner settled an insider-trading lawsuit
items.description: The backstory of the prediction market industry's newest entrant has done little to calm concerns as it partners with several giants of sports broadcasting.
